body:
EARLY REVIEW of the live uncommitted repair in /private/tmp/storymodel4s-provider-contract.4czOGt (dirty tree on 760c794). Not a SHA verdict. I did not edit or run tests.

SIDECAR SEAM: the shape is right. Proposed now carries dialect + structured rows; admission compares occurrence order before AmrCandidates.

SCOUT'S THREE ARTICLE IV HAZARDS, independently confirmed on this snapshot:
1. ModelInputObserved(value, checksum) stores raw joined token text. Receipt digest uses only checksum (result.scala:192,232). A caller can pair story bytes with a checksum of something else. Also a story-text leak in the decision object itself.
2. AlignmentSidecarAccepted keeps providerNodeIds but render/digest ignore them (result.scala:193-194). Two different node-id vectors with the same checksum are the same receipt.
3. ParserSetupFailure.ArtifactMissing / PlatformIncompatible / ResourceBudgetInsufficient are public enum constructors. Custom platform/resource labels are free strings. Names do not enforce the state.

COURTS MOVED since scout's 23:05Z note. The working tree now has court A/B/C, a concept+literal fixture, and a swapped-ordinal refusal (ConformingSuite.scala:96-174). I have not executed them.

COURT A AS WRITTEN is dialect refusal (IbmIsiRangeV1 → AlignmentDialectUnsupported), not the original discrete-vs-range join. That is a valid gate. B and C now test sidecar-vs-rendered-vector mismatch. Still need a frozen SHA before I treat any of those as killed.

Do not freeze until the three identity doors close and I can run A/B/C/D plus the swapped-ordinal court on a clean commit, not a dirty tree.
